Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

quod

conjunction: with the indicative for the speaker’s own reason, with the subjunctive for a reason reported or rejected

because; the fact that …; that, the fact that

In this lexicon

  • because

    the recommended word · classical · Varr. LL 5.76: noctua, quod noctū canit et vigilat; Hor. S. 1.6.119–120: nōn sollicitus, mihi quod crās surgendum sit māne

  • fact

    also used · classical · Cic. Att. 2.4.1: fēcistī mihi pergrātum, quod Serāpiōnis librum ad mē mīsistī; Traupman 97

  • that

    also used · classical · Plin. Ep. 4.1.1: grātum est utrīque nostrum quod cupis

  • quod agās: activity

    classical

  • habēre quod dēs: afford

    classical

  • accēdit quod: further

    classical

  • quod sī (quodsī): if

    classical

  • tantum quod: just now

    classical

  • vehiculum birotum quod pede prōpellitur: kick scooter

    our formation

  • quod sciam: knowledge

    classical

  • quod rogō: question

    classical

  • nihil est quod (+ subjunctive): reason

    classical

  • quod ad … attinet: respect

    classical

  • dīcō quod (quia) …: that

    late Latin

  • nōn est quod (+ subjunctive): there is

    classical

  • id quod (quod): what

    classical

Examples

  • noctua, quod noctū canit et vigilat

    the little owl (is so called) because it sings and stays awake at nightVarr. LL 5.76

    In the entry for because

  • deinde eō dormītum, nōn sollicitus, mihi quod crās surgendum sit māne

    then I go to bed, not worried that I must get up early tomorrowHor. S. 1.6.119–120

    In the entry for because

  • fēcistī mihi pergrātum, quod Serāpiōnis librum ad mē mīsistī

    it was very kind of you to send me Serapio’s bookCic. Att. 2.4.1

    In the entry for fact

  • cupis post longum tempus neptem tuam mēque ūnā vidēre. grātum est utrīque nostrum quod cupis

    you want to see your granddaughter and me together after a long time; we are both glad that you want toPlin. Ep. 4.1.1

    In the entry for that
